decks.notes: The main concept of this Jeskai Control deck is to use a combination of card draw, removal spells, and powerful enchantments to control the board and outvalue the opponent. By efficiently managing resources and using cards like Abandon Attachments and Accumulate Wisdom to generate card advantage, the deck aims to stall the game until it can set up powerful win conditions like Jeskai Revelation and Combustion Technique. The deck also utilizes versatile lands like Great Hall of the Biblioplex and Riverpyre Verge to ensure smooth mana development.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of powerful creatures and support spells. The key idea is to establish board presence early on with efficient creatures like Aang, Swift Savior and Cecil, Dark Knight, while protecting them with cards like Arachne, Psionic Weaver and Key to the Side-Door. The deck also includes a variety of powerful legends such as Nick Fury, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. and Elektra, Daughter of the Hand to provide additional utility and versatility in different situations. The goal is to maintain pressure and control the game from start to finish.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing various spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain board advantage. The deck includes cards like Opt, Traumatic Critique, and Spell Snare to manipulate card draw, counter spells, and remove threats from the opponent's side of the field. Additionally, it includes powerful creatures like Hearth Elemental and Eddymurk Crab to apply pressure and finish off the opponent. The deck aims to outsmart and outmaneuver the opponent with strategic plays and efficient use of resources.

The main concept of this deck is to strategically bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard and onto the battlefield. By using a combination of cards that allow for graveyard manipulation and reanimation, the player aims to overwhelm their opponent with strong creature presence. Additionally, there are cards included to disrupt the opponent's hand and control the board state. The deck combines elements of combo and reanimator strategies to create a unique and powerful playstyle. Overall, the key focus is on effectively utilizing graveyard resources to gain an advantage in the game.

The main concept of this Jeskai Control deck is to maintain control of the board through various removal spells like Day of Judgment and Spell Snare, while also drawing cards for card advantage with Tablet of Discovery and Jeskai Revelation. The deck also aims to protect itself with counterspells like No More Lies and maintain a strong late-game presence with powerful finishers like North Wind Avatar. The mana base is optimized for all three colors of the Jeskai shard, ensuring that spells can be cast efficiently and consistently.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming your opponent with efficient creatures and buffs, utilizing the synergy between mono green cards and land ramp. By swarming the board early with creatures like Llanowar Elves and Icetill Explorer, you can establish a strong presence and pressure your opponent. Cards like Earthbender Ascension and Mightform Harmonizer allow you to give your creatures additional power to close out games quickly. The deck also includes cards like Escape Tunnel and Fabled Passage to ensure consistent mana sources and card draw to maintain pressure on your opponent.

This deck focuses on filling the board with powerful creatures quickly and overwhelming the opponent with aggression. Utilizing cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre and Case of the Uneaten Feast, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and force the opponent to react defensively. With a mix of efficient creatures and disruptive spells like Emptiness and Erode, the deck aims to control the game and secure victory in the early to mid-game. The inclusion of cards like Aunt May and Lunar Convocation provide additional value and card advantage, further increasing the deck's overall power level.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and spells. Utilizing cards like Ba Sing Se and Earthbender Ascension, you can rapidly build a formidable board presence. Cards like Icetill Explorer and Sazh's Chocobo provide additional aggression, while Dyadrine, Synthesis Amalgam and Mightform Harmonizer help to strengthen your creatures. With a mix of removal spells like Erode and Demolition Field, combined with mana acceleration from Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage, this deck aims to outpace and outmuscle your opponent.

The primary focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced attacking strategy using creatures with high power and abilities that boost their strength. Utilizing cards like Ba Sing Se, Earthbender Ascension, and Surrak, Elusive Hunter, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and apply pressure to the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Sapling Nursery and Demolition Field provide support and control options to help maintain board advantage and facilitate more aggressive plays.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of spells and removal cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes a variety of counterspells, board wipes, and card draw effects to maintain card advantage and answer threats efficiently. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and enable the player to cast their spells consistently. The goal is to outvalue the opponent by managing resources effectively and eventually overwhelm them with powerful spells like Jeskai Revelation.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive mono green creatures, while also utilizing cards like Snakeskin Veil and Meltstrider's Resolve to protect your key creatures. Additionally, cards like Earthbender Ascension and Mightform Harmonizer help to pump up your creatures and make them even more threatening. The deck also includes some land search and protection cards like Fabled Passage and Escape Tunnel to ensure consistent mana availability and keep your creatures safe.

The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and spell cards that focus on aggression and control. The deck aims to play aggressively by using powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Abhorrent Oculus, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Duress and Requiting Hex. Cards like Jadzi, Steward of Fate and Kiora, the Rising Tide provide additional versatility and card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Wail of the Forgotten and Bitter Triumph for removal and to maintain board control.

The main concept of this deck is to have a fast-paced aggressive strategy with a focus on utilizing cheap spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck includes a mix of direct damage spells, creature enhancements, and efficient creatures to apply pressure early in the game. Additionally, there are cards that provide versatility such as bounce spells and card draw, allowing for adaptability in different situations. The mana base is built for consistency and speed, enabling the deck to consistently execute its game plan.

This deck revolves around utilizing control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage and board presence. Eddymurk Crab and Sunderflock provide early-game defense, while Impractical Joke and Flow State help to stall the opponent's plans. Hearth Elemental and Prismari Charm offer versatile removal options, while Traumatic Critique and Multiversal Passage provide late-game win conditions. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent with efficient spells and creatures, ultimately overwhelming them with a combination of direct damage and strategic disruption.

The main focus of this Azorius Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Aang, Swift Savior and Aven Interrupter, while utilizing cards like No More Lies and Spell Pierce to disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck also includes powerful spells like Avatar's Wrath and Erode to control the battlefield and maintain pressure.
